title: dendrite initiation and propagation in lithium metal solid-state batteries
chunk:
To focus on the fundamental understanding of dendrites, all cells contained Li metal electrodes in the pristine state. Anodeless conditions and cycling efficiencies would require a separate study.

# Implications

Lidendrites and short circuits can be suppressed by inhibiting either the initiation or the propagation of cracks in the solid electrolyte, and the means of doing so differ. For a sintered $\mathrm{Li}_6\mathrm{PS}_5\mathrm{Cl}$ argyrodite electrolyte, using measurements of the microscopic (grain boundary) fracture strength, pore size and population density, a critical current for initiation of approximately $1.0\mathrm{mAcm}^{-2}$ was calculated. The experimentally reported range is $0.5 - 3.0\mathrm{mA cm}^{-2}$ (refs. 4,23).

title: practically accessible all‐solid‐state batteries enabled by organosulfide cathodes and sulfide electrolytes
chunk:
A dry-film fabrication protocol was introduced to develop the first sheet-type organic ASSB based on sulfide electrolytes. The as-fabricated freestanding $\mathrm{Li}_6\mathrm{PS}_5\mathrm{Cl}$ electrolyte membrane is a mere $48~{\mu\mathrm{m}}$ thick, exhibiting an ultralow areal resistance of $3.9\Omega \mathrm{cm}^2$ , which significantly boosts the cell-level energy density and minimized the cell internal resistance. This work opens the door to develop practically accessible organic ASSBs optimized at the material, electrode, and cell levels.

title: a self‐healable sulfide/polymer composite electrolyte for long‐life, low‐lithium‐excess lithium‐metal batteries
chunk:
For the ex situ based anode protection strategy, it is critical to forming a dense, robust, non-porous interphase layer. One important pathway to achieve this is to combine an ion-conducting solid electrolyte filler and a mechanically strong

polymer to create an artificial protective layer.[26-28] Sulfide solid electrolytes are a superior choice for the ion-conducting phase in the artificial protective layer, considering excellent transport properties (typically $0.1 - 10\mathrm{mScm}^{-1}$ ) and facile processing conditions.[29-34] Moreover, sulfide solid electrolytes can be stabilized on the Li-metal anode surface after the interface modification.[35-39] Although promising, the artificial protective layer, which is composed of the sulfide solid electrolyte and polymer binder, still faces multiple chemo-mechanical challenges.
